title: Seasonal heat peak
text: Month 4 has the highest 2015–2025 mean daily maximum temperature: 39.61 °C. This describes the selected grid cell, not personal heat exposure.

title: Rainfall seasonality
text: June–September contributes 91.3% of total precipitation in the 2015–2025 grid-cell series. Drainage maintenance planning can use this seasonal concentration, not individual flood predictions.

title: Wettest study year
text: 2019 has the largest annual precipitation total in this dataset: 3387.3 mm. This is not evidence of flood occurrence.
